description: Angular component for AI Model dialog, including form handling, validation, and interactions with AI model service.

classes.name: AIModelDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for AI Model configuration dialog, managing form state, validation, and interactions.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Fetches model options based on search text, filtering model list for the selected provider.

methods.name: updateApiKeyValidatorForOpenAIProvider
methods.description: Adjusts validation rules for API key based on the provider's base URL.

methods.name: getAuthenticationHint
methods.description: Provides user hints for authentication types based on current selection.

methods.name: updateValidation
methods.description: Enables or disables form fields based on selected provider.

methods.name: checkConnectivity
methods.description: Opens a dialog to check connectivity of the AI model configuration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Saves the AI model configuration via the service and closes the dialog.
